nedenler: Alarm) Stored LOGIC FAILURE #1 This alarm is displayed when the controller detects an overvoltage or undervoltage condition.
kontroller: • The key input signal voltage drops below theth e undervoltage threshold due external loads, such as DC/DC converters starting up or relays or contactors energizing or de-energizing.
• If no voltage transient is detected on the supply line and the alarm is displayed every time the key is switched ON, the problem is in the COMBIACX controller.
• If the alarm occurs during traction acceleration or driving hydraulic functions, it is caused by an undervoltage condition.

nedenler: Alarm) Stored PUMP VMN LOW Cause 1: Startup test Before switching the main contactor on, the software checks the power bridge.
kontroller: • Motor internal connections (ohmic continuity) • Motor power connections • Motor leakage to the truck frame If the motor connections are OK, the problem is in the COMBIACX controller.

• Motor connections • Whether the motor’s phase windings or cables have leakages towards the truck frame • That the main contactor closes properly, with a good contact If no faults are found, the problem is in the COMBIACX controller.
